title: Azimuthal Quantum Number
description: The nonnegative integer ell that labels an atomic orbital's angular momentum magnitude and subshell. The familiar s, p, d and f subshells have ell equal to 0, 1, 2 and 3.

relations.note: Ell specifies an eigenvalue of the squared orbital angular momentum operator.
Ell labels the orbital's angular factor and subshell.
